page.overview:
Who is Kenneth Haigh?

Kenneth William Michael Haigh was an English actor. He was born on March 25th, 1931. He played the role as Simon Marshall in A Hard Day's Night. However, he is uncredited in the film. Haigh died on February 4th, 2018 at the age of 86.

He had spent his last years in a nursing home after oxygen deprivation led to brain damage in 2003, following his accidental swallowing of a bone in a restaurant in Soho.
